screening_measurement_notes: Weights are source JSON numeric percentages parsed with Decimal; both bases retained, missing values counted explicitly. Raw all-row sums are not admitted W; no normalization or inferred cash.
A source securityId string is not automatically CUSIP; the dedicated cusip/isin/sedol fields remain separately measured.
REIT-labelled positions may be ordinary equity instruments but need mapping; the REIT label alone is not a derivative exclusion.
Absence of an observed derivative is not proof that a strategy can never use one. Prospective eligibility needs its actual source contract and strategy evidence.
Product JSON screening does not represent 31 downloaded XLSX files. Only the earlier JGRO workbook was fetched. Other product-page URLs are derived leads, not fetched HTML.
Source CURRENCIES rows with codes CCC and USQ are unresolved issuer codes; they are not classified as verified non-USD currencies. Known non-USD codes and unresolved codes are counted separately.

repeat_observation.comparison_basis: Every ZIP entry except docProps/core.xml has identical uncompressed bytes, including the entire worksheet and sharedStrings. Thus the 140 positions, all source fields, date and notices are identical.
repeat_observation.interpretation: Different XLSX bytes alone do not establish a holdings correction or new date. This is a distinct acquisition observation of the same financial disclosure, with changed document/ZIP metadata.

second_date_requirement.next_action: Second-date capture complete for JGRO. Validate both dated samples under fund/date admission rules; continue separate earlier-archive investigation only through verified routes. Other proposed launch funds still need their own dated evidence.
second_date_requirement.periodic_report_status: Observed product-page document links reported by parallel contract review; not fetched in this subtask. A periodic report could establish a historical portfolio date, but not two comparable daily XLSX captures.

Public service method in the same script constructs the exact observed query including version9.19_1793249641; no date parameter guessed.
previous_historical_endpoint_review.daily_download_date_parameter: None in inspected official dailyETFHoldings download control.
previous_historical_endpoint_review.conclusion: The exact public history response supplies no JGRO historical holdings or available holding dates. The generic script contains date-based PCF/holding controls, but those tabs/fields are not enabled/populated for this fund. No PCF endpoint or speculative archive URL was requested. This bounded review does not prove no historical source exists anywhere.

two_date_comparison.interpretation: The current official file has advanced to 6 November. Two daily XLSX files were captured on successive observation dates. This establishes two distinct local source samples, not a public archive or an accepted analytical fund.

history_review.explanation_of_previous_gap: The first review and repeat retrieval both occurred on 6 November while the latest file still reported 5 November; no earlier date was exposed by the checked holdings-history response. On 7 November the official current file reports 6 November, so prospective capture now supplies the second date. Daily publication does not imply a public downloadable daily archive, and daily price history is a different dataset.

history_leads.periodic_reports: Official quarterly/annual report links are separate dated-source leads, not established daily-format history. The observed prospectus wrapper points to a document host outside active policy; report destinations and contents have not been fetched in this follow-up.
history_leads.provider_or_issuer_archive: An issuer or data provider may retain older daily holdings; availability, access and terms have not been verified. No inquiry sent.
history_leads.prospective_retention: Continue permitted daily captures with actual retrieval times to build our own history; not backdated knowledge. No recurring job created.

definitions.subject: NAV
definitions.quote: A fund's NAV is the sum of all its assets less any liabilities, divided by the number of shares outstanding.
definitions.conclusion: Issuer defines per-share NAV. This alone does not establish the exact liability/timing basis used for each downloadable holding weight.

definitions.subject: Top-ten holdings basis and exclusions
definitions.quote: The top holdings shown exclude cash and money market positions (including cash or cash collateral, money market instruments, and currencies) and do not include short positions.
definitions.second_quote: Each holding is presented as a percentage of the ETF's net assets.
definitions.conclusion: This is the top-ten display disclosure, not a definition that removes cash from the full workbook. Do not use top10 as the complete portfolio or extend this specific text to all workbook columns.

definitions.subject: Rounding
definitions.quote: Due to rounding, values may not total 100%.
definitions.conclusion: Positive source acknowledgement of rounding; not authority to normalize weights or waive current metric tolerance. Exact rounding algorithm/tie treatment remains unverified.

definitions.subject: Market Value versus Net Assets weights
definitions.conclusion: Two explicitly distinct reported bases; preserve both. The source labels establish names, but exact denominator construction and timing need reconciliation before canonical selection.

definitions.subject: Dollar units and fund identity
definitions.conclusion: USD and NYSE-Arca are explicit source metadata; currency is also explicit in the workbook Market Value (USD) header. Do not infer country semantics from currency/exchange.

diagnostics.arithmetic: Decimal parsed directly from source JSON, independently checked against prior workbook sums. Diagnostic only, not replacement analytical weights.
diagnostics.cause_of_negative_cash: not_established; do not assert unsettled transactions, borrowing, receivables/payables or an accounting error without source evidence
diagnostics.interpretation: The public assets reference is consistent with same-date NAV times shares to USD0.015 at published precision, but the signed holding-value ratio (about99.9385%) does not equal the total of reported Net Assets weights (100.06%).
